description: This is a 3D model preview of two tall, white, open-back bookshelves. The bookshelves are identical in design, featuring multiple shelves spaced evenly throughout their height. The model presents them side-by-side against a light gray background. One of the bookshelves has a label at its base indicating 'Full BILLY Shelf 80 x 28 x 202 cm', suggesting it's a specific product. Below the other bookshelf, the text 'Shelf parts' is visible. This implies the model might be used to showcase a complete shelving unit and its components.
